column7: Decides whether a stdio backend session is established: refuses a backend initialize error, a rejection listing no revision this gateway speaks, and a negotiated retry the backend still rejects, and adopts only a checked_selection revision; backend error text is reported by code only.
Picks which implemented identity-minting strategy startup installs (SignedAssertion or TokenExchange, never Vault or Passthrough); a mistake silently installs the wrong minting machinery or none.
Computes the GW.3 startup warning naming backends whose gateway-held OAuth token leaks across users under auth.single_user; a mistake silently hides the operator's only signal of that leak.
Builds the per-key and global budget enforcer and restores today's spend from costs.json; a mistake silently resets spend on restart and loosens every budget.
Persists today's spend under the write lock so the next boot restores it; a mistake silently loses spend and loosens budgets after a restart.
Sets the longest frame the reader accepts from the backend, clamped to CEILING_MAX_FRAME_BYTES; a mistake silently lifts the size cap on an untrusted peer.
Sends initialized and only then marks the transport connected; a mistake silently admits requests before the handshake that initialize decides has completed.
Issues the unique request id the pending map routes each response by; a reused id silently hands one caller's response to another.
Registers the minted progress token and records whether this call owns it, so a second call cannot deregister the first's routing; a mistake silently misattributes progress across calls.
Wires each call's progress registration, pending-response guard and cancel claim around the exchange; a mistake silently routes a response or progress to the wrong caller or strands an entry.
Removes a finished call's progress routing; a stale entry silently delivers a later call's progress to the wrong caller.
